clusters.name: Teodor's death, 1978–1979
clusters.reason: Around Teodor's death in January 1978: within months, Delphine stopped cooking and fell in functioning, turned toward her mother Odette, Duncan took night shifts and distanced from Odette, Anton's drinking rose, Duncan's anxiety rose over his mother and Anton, and Callum developed ear infections. Hazel's quarrel with Simone over selling the house is undated and struck. These shifts pile up around the loss of the key elder on Teodor's side of the family.

clusters.name: Odette ordered to bed, 1984–1984
clusters.reason: Around Odette ordered to bed for the rest of pregnancy in March 1984: within months, Hazel came every morning to keep the house, Duncan argued with his mother over how she kept it, and Callum stammered again. These shifts pile up around the drop in Odette's functioning, with Hazel's overfunctioning and Duncan's reaction to it. Maren's anxiety at bedtime is undated and struck.

clusters.name: Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis, 1986–1996
clusters.reason: Around Hazel's diagnosis in September 1986: over the next decade, Ambrose took over her care, Duncan phoned his father nightly for news, argued with Lyle over who should help, developed chest pains, stopped visiting his parents, drank most evenings, and fought with Odette over his time there. Hazel fell and rose in functioning, could no longer dress or stand, Odette took her to clinic twice weekly, Mavis came to nurse her, and Pearl developed panic spells. This is one long climb in the family's involvement with Hazel's decline, each step a shift with only partial relief, no quiet falls between them, ending with her move to the nursing home in June 1997 and Duncan's drinking cut back.

clusters.name: Callum left home, 1999–2000
clusters.reason: Around Callum leaving for work up north in May 1999: within months, Duncan and Callum argued over his plans, Odette's anxiety rose at the thought of him so far away, Duncan missed work and sat in the garage, Ines skipped school most of autumn, Odette took Ines everywhere, and Ines went back to school and passed her exams by August 2000. These shifts pile up as the household adjusted to Callum's departure, with Odette turning toward Ines and both Duncan and Ines struggling.

clusters.name: Hazel's death, 2003–2003
clusters.reason: Around Hazel's death in January 2003: within months, Maren could not sleep, stopped going to the bookshop and was let go, dreaded buses and crowded shops, and went out only after dark. By November, Maren took a job at the garden centre and slept through the night again. These are Maren's shifts only, tied to the loss of her grandmother whom the household had turned around for years. Maren's distance from her mother is undated and struck.
